title: Hyperbased
scope: Complete 333.84-second three-channel arrangement. Source channel 4 is sampled, channels 2 and 1 use SID recipes, and channel 3 remains omitted. Sample bandwidth/volume are quantized; chords are arpeggiated. This is not an exact four-channel MOD reproduction.

pcm_input.quality: Nearest q16 volume levels with half steps rounded upward. Additional per-instrument low-pass decimation preserves original clocks and note periods but lowers sampled bandwidth. Instruments 2–6 retain the accepted excerpt's decimation.
pcm_input.loop_model: Looped initial DMA end is ceil(source first-pass bytes/divisor); repeat begins at round(source loop start/divisor). One-shot ends are page-rounded with neutral padding only. Eight-bit fractional phase is retained across repeat; resampled endpoint rounding is disclosed pitch quantization.
pcm_input.runtime_contract: Mute bit requires constant neutral reads while cursor advances. Physical bank prefix ends are not logical sample ends. Ended one-shots stay silent through gain changes until a retrigger.

synth_input.scope: Full-length three-channel adaptation. SID source channels 2 and 1; source channel 3 stays omitted. Chords use declared arpeggio recipes; amplitude fades are approximated.

compression.format: Three page-aligned state dictionaries, independent 12-tick chunks and direct 16-bit chunk-pointer playlist
compression.scope: All source sample retriggers, gain/mute selections and SID register states survive compression exactly. Sample preparation and SID approximation remain separate quality choices.

native_playback.scope: Streaming verification of every sampled input and latch, every ordered ordinary-voice frequency/control write and its frame, completed buffers and constant master volume. Does not establish original timbre, physical SID fidelity or perceived balance.

audio.processing: Actual VICE WAV, clock-anchored crop, DC removal and one constant gain. No host mixing, EQ, alignment, time stretching or dynamics.

cpu_budget.scope: Unmodified native program; monitor instruction tracepoints only. Hardware-entry/RTI costs included, final non-returning NMI excluded from average. Fill timing ends at the RTS instruction; six cycles are included in deadline readiness. Variable-frame deadlines come from actual boundary NMIs. Every profiler-run latch still has a 126-cycle interval. No audio or physical SID quality claim.

independent_source_reference.comparison: Independent decoder order, row, pattern and speed after each rendered tick
independent_source_reference.timing_note: Original uses ideal 50 Hz libopenmpt ticks; physical PAL CIA timer quantization is a separate backend constraint.
independent_source_reference.scope: Checks whole-song score timing and independently renders original audio. Does not prove effect-pitch equivalence or SID timbre quality.

fresh_rebuild.scope: Fresh host preparation and assembly, plus a real JSON setting mutation in a temporary copied library. No second full-song audio run or mutated listening file.

excerpt_preservation.scope: Instrument data and per-tick SID states match the accepted source37.44–48.00s excerpt. Full-song sample-clock boundary phase differs from a standalone cut, so no WAV time-alignment or bit-identity claim is made.

sample_model_checks.scope: Independent scalar cursor replay checked all emitted sample values and every audible physical read against stored prefixes. No native VICE claim.

source_change_note: Final host-side fixes consume explicit library voice settings, remove report-only per-recipe pulse widths and protect generated instrument files. Fresh preparation/assembly proves the captured program and expected PCM/SID states remain identical.
